Geometry.Desc: Contains the geometry description of the aircraft

SurfaceRefPoint.Desc: position of wing to global point of reference

r_Surface.Desc: Position of the wing to global point of reference in x-direction

y_Surface.Desc: Position of the wing to global point of reference in y-direction

h_Surface.Desc: Position of the wing to global point of reference in z-direction

SurfaceParameters.Desc: Parametric description of lifting surface geometry

RelChordRefForRotation.Desc: Rel. Chordtiefe: Ref.-Pkt. fuer Verwindg. u. V-Stellg.

i_Surface.Desc: Angle of incidence in reference to the aircrafts coordinate system

SectionPoints.Desc: number of points of profile. Will be used by spline interpolation if DoInterpolate attribute is set true

HalfSurfaceDescription.Desc: Parameters of right wing (or both wings, if symmetric)

HalfSurfaceSegments.Desc: Number of wing segments in this half surface

InnerProfile_Segment.Desc: Inner airfoil segment. Geometry is stored in seperate file (*.dat)

OuterProfile_Segment.Desc: Outer airfoil segment. Geometry is stored in seperate file (*.dat)

l_i_Segment.Desc: Chord length of segments inner profile

l_o_Segment.Desc: Chord length of segments outer profile

epsilon_Segment.Desc: Angle of twist of wing segment

nu_Segment.Desc: Angle of dihedral of wing segment

phi_Segment.Desc: Leading edge sweep angle of wing segment

l_rel_i_FrontSpar.Desc: Relative chord position of front spar from leading edge of inner section

l_rel_i_RearSpar.Desc: Relative chord position of rear spar from leading edge of inner section

l_rel_o_FrontSpar.Desc: Relative chord position of front spar from leading edge of outer section
